mobile.tokenStore: SecureStore medicard.auth.token (WHEN_UNLOCKED_THIS_DEVICE_ONLY); web localStorage; in-memory cache
mobile.sessionSnapshot: medicard.session.snapshot preference; painted only if jwtSubject(token) matches snapshot.user.id
mobile.accountScope: getScopedPreference prefixes accountId; wipeLegacyUnscopedHealthCaches on adopt/hydrate

server.userJwt: HS256 jsonwebtoken, env.JWT_SECRET, default 30d, payload { sub, email }
server.revocation: none; logout is client clearToken; deleted user → requireAuth 401
server.requireAuth: Bearer required; admin role 403 on user APIs; missing user 401; BLOCKED 403
server.partner: cycle share token on /api/cycle/share*; public /api/cycle/share/:code closed
